checks.name: Restored production catalog fingerprint matches hosted read-only capture
Unapproved execution is refused before any schema change
Baseline drift stops the entire package
A late duplicate-review failure rolls back all earlier DDL, bucket metadata and financial changes
A changed Storage policy baseline blocks migration before private-photo rules can be weakened
Retained legacy Checkout evidence requires an explicit reconciliation acknowledgement
Active Checkout holds block cutover even after acknowledgement
Preservation guard detects an injected historical-field rewrite and rolls back the complete package
Complete production package commits against the exact restored production catalog
All original columns and rows survive: 29 paid bookings, two extensions, messages, profiles, reviews and listing data
No historical email, refund, fee-credit or photo-deletion work is queued
Browser roles cannot read or write private money/delivery queues; every new public table uses RLS
Required application RPCs are service-only and readiness probes return true
BUG-005200 anonymous profile projection and count are denied
BUG-005200 Driver and Host can read only their own sign-in profile
BUG-005200 explicit foreign ID and broad OR filter cannot enumerate profiles
BUG-005200 counts and pagination expose only the caller row
BUG-005200 absent identity cannot use authenticated profile grants
BUG-005200 browser cannot read email or Stripe fields even on own profile
BUG-005200 extra permissive read policy cannot reopen the account directory
BUG-005200 server retains account access while browser profile writes stay denied
Financial FKs prevent listing, profile or Auth deletion from cascading away paid history
New canonical scheduled bookings use the supplied UTC instant and retain the property-zone snapshot
Direct Host requests cannot rewrite trusted property coordinates or time zones
Photo bucket starts private and Storage policies scope writes to the owning Host

BUG-005119 unrelated and missing identities see no messages

BUG-005119 filtered counts cannot reveal another Driver thread
BUG-005119 server retains insertion/read access and legacy participant is not inferred
